title: Research: external subtitle quality evaluation tools
objective: Survey external subtitle quality evaluation tools that complement the existing deterministic TypeScript Subtitle Quality Engine. Cover: SubER (apptek, Apache 2.0, segmentation+timing-aware edit distance, WER/BLEU/TER on SRT), EvalSubtitle/Sigma (fyvo, Apache 2.0, segmentation quality scoring), SubSonar (hlt-mt, Apache 2.0, semantic similarity via SONAR embeddings). For each: what it measures, how it differs from the existing CPS/overlap/duration engine, integration point (benchmark harness vs runtime), install command. Recommend which to adopt as the primary CI benchmark metric. Write results to docs/research/RESEARCH-SUBTITLE-QUALITY-001.md only.
